missing.skip_tooltip: Leave this package off this device

title.one: 1 package from your other devices is not here
title.other: {count} packages from your other devices are not here

applied.one: 1 file came from your other devices
applied.other: {count} files came from your other devices

notify.failed: Resurrect could not save your setup
notify.held: Resurrect held back files that gave Hyprland config errors

settings.one: 1 Noctalia setting came from your other devices
settings.other: {count} Noctalia settings came from your other devices

restore.confirm: A terminal opens and asks which device's save to use, then before each step: packages, dotfiles, shared and this device's own, Noctalia's settings and plugins, services, and your own steps. Files it replaces are backed up first.

hooks.one: 1 step of your own, in hooks/
hooks.other: {count} steps of your own, in hooks/

saved.hooks_any: Steps of your own, in hooks/
saved.title: Saved each time

daily.description: Save the setup once a day, as long as Noctalia runs.
daily.label: Save every day

device_files.description: Files and folders that stay on this device, such as ~/.config/hypr/monitors.lua. They are saved, but not shared.
device_files.label: Only this device

files.description: Files and folders in your home folder to save, such as ~/.config/hypr. Do not add files with passwords or keys if the repository is pushed.
files.label: Dotfiles

folder.description: The git repository the setup is saved in. It is created when missing.
folder.label: Repository folder

noctalia.description: Save Noctalia's config and the settings changed in its settings window.
noctalia.label: Save Noctalia's settings

packages.description: Save the list of packages you installed, from pacman, the AUR, apt, dnf and Flatpak.
packages.label: Save packages

remote.description: A git remote to push each save to, such as a private repository on GitHub. Leave empty to keep the saves on this device.
remote.label: Push to

services.description: Save which system and user services start by themselves.
services.label: Save services

share.description: Share the dotfiles with your other devices that push to the same repository. What one device changes reaches the others on their next save. Needs Push to.
share.label: Share between devices

setup.body: Resurrect needs git. Install it with your package manager, then open this panel again.

status.local: Only on this device. Set Push to in the settings to keep a copy elsewhere.
status.shared: Shared with your other devices that push here.

waiting.held: Held back: these gave Hyprland config errors here.
waiting.theirs_held: Takes it even though it gave config errors
